findings.text: suppressing BatchEntryRefusedError around read.write_paths makes a section whose sentence names a test only by description, or carries a parent-directory token, derive nothing and keep the default landing scope, while a batch entry for that same section refuses naming the sentence at dispatch_batch.py:444 and dispatch_batch.py:474; the single dispatch silently reproduces the failure the section describes, and the coordinator learns of this only when the worker's commit is refused as outside its scope.

SECTION_SUPPLIED_NODE_FIELDS is documented as the node fields a section supplies to a dispatch that omits them, but write paths now belong to that set and are not in the tuple, so a reader or later caller that enumerates the constant to decide which fields the section owns (as the batch writer does when it stamps section_derived marks at dispatch_batch.py:938) cannot see the new field.
